from openpyxl import load_workbook
from pathlib import Path
from collections import OrderedDict

input_path = Path("/mnt/data/spreadsheet/575-16/1_575-16_input.xlsx")
output_path = Path("/mnt/data/outputs/575-16_1_7a0b0113/1_575-16_output.xlsx")

# Load one workbook for values and one to preserve workbook contents/styles while editing only target cells
wb_vals = load_workbook(input_path, data_only=True)
ws_vals = wb_vals["Sheet1"]

wb = load_workbook(input_path)
ws = wb["Sheet1"]

# Group class codes by student code, preserving the original vertical order.
groups = OrderedDict()
for r in range(2, ws_vals.max_row + 1):  # row 1 contains headers
    student = ws_vals.cell(r, 1).value
    class_code = ws_vals.cell(r, 2).value
    if student is None and class_code is None:
        continue
    if student is None:
        continue
    if student not in groups:
        groups[student] = []
    if class_code is not None:
        groups[student].append(class_code)

# Clear and fill only the allowed answer range: G11:R13
start_row, end_row = 11, 13
start_col, end_col = 7, 18  # G:R

for row in range(start_row, end_row + 1):
    for col in range(start_col, end_col + 1):
        ws.cell(row, col).value = None

for out_row, (student, classes) in zip(range(start_row, end_row + 1), groups.items()):
    values = [student] + classes
    for offset, value in enumerate(values[:end_col - start_col + 1]):
        ws.cell(out_row, start_col + offset).value = value

wb.save(output_path)
